name: TwistingData.excessWeight_dotProduct_permStep
summary: Expand the dot product letter by letter; the contributions telescope around the cycle of letters, leaving the terms at the letter i.

steps.claim: Let F(s) = P^{1 + (s − i) mod N}·(ν(a, s+1) − ν(a', s+1))/q.
steps.lean: let F s := T.P ^ (1 + (s - i).val) * (ν (a, s + 1) - ν (a', s + 1)) / T.q

steps.claim: Write the dot product as a sum over the letters s, add and subtract Σ_s F(s) = Σ_s F(s − 1) (shift of the summation variable), so that all summands except the one at s = i cancel (excessWeight evaluated by parity and one_add_val_sub_one_sub); the summand at i gives (1 − 1/q)(β(u_i) − (ν(a, i) − ν(a', i))) after field simplification (p ≠ 0).
steps.lean:
rw [dotProduct, sum_prod_type_right, ← add_sub_cancel_right (∑ _, _), ← sum_add_distrib,
    ← (Equiv.subRight 1).sum_comp F, ← sum_sub_distrib, Fintype.sum_eq_single i] <;> intros <;>
    by_cases T.isEven ‹_› <;> simp [F, excessWeight, ↓one_add_val_sub_one_sub, rootVar,
    division_def, sub_mul, *] <;> field [T.prime.ne_zero]
